units.headline: CompactStaleHead now delegates to shared compactHeadViewLocked with an eviction watermark
units.summary: The stale-head block-writing loop moved into compactHeadViewLocked, shared with CompactSelectedSeries. Stale compaction now uses NewSelectedSeriesHead and evicts via truncateStaleSeries with an appendID watermark, so series that got newer samples during the write are no longer evicted.
units.reason: Persistence and head eviction logic changed: new view type, eviction watermark, and block-write loop moved to a shared helper.
risk_signals: block-write loop moved to shared helper
focus: stale blocks still get the stale hint and the same time ranges as before the move
eviction now skips series with appends above the watermark and the effect on stale-series counters
block write and reload error cleanup behaves the same as the old inline loop

units.headline: inOrderBlocksMaxTime now also ignores selected-series blocks
units.summary: Blocks carrying the from-selected-series hint are excluded from the in-order max time, as stale and out-of-order blocks already were. This value sets the WAL-replay and head truncation cutoff, so a wrong value can drop WAL-only samples.
units.reason: Changes the cutoff that drives head truncation and WAL replay, where an error silently loses data.
focus: every code path that writes selected-series blocks sets the hint, including merged blocks
no regular in-order block can carry the hint and be wrongly ignored

units.headline: Moved two merge-hint tests lower in db_test.go
units.summary: TestStaleBlockNotMergedWithNonStaleBlock and TestOutOfOrderBlockMergePreservesHint are removed here and re-added later in the same file with only the doc comments changed. Coverage is kept, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
units.reason: Test-only move; both tests reappear in the same PR with the same body, so no assertion is lost.

units.headline: Test comment now names gcSeries instead of gcStaleSeries
units.summary: Only a code comment in a test changed, to match the renamed eviction function. Nothing executes differently.
units.reason: Comment-only edit inside a test; no code or assertion changed.

units.headline: New test: selected-series blocks excluded from inOrderBlocksMaxTime
units.summary: Adds a test that compacts a selected series and checks the resulting block has the selected hint and that inOrderBlocksMaxTime reports no in-order block. It is a new test with no production effect.
units.reason: New test only; it adds coverage for the new exclusion and changes no production code.
